hooks.command: bash -c 'TOPLEVEL=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$TOPLEVEL" ]; then PULL=$(git -C "$TOPLEVEL" pull --ff-only origin main 2>&1); if echo "$PULL" | grep -q "Already up to date"; then echo "[auto-pull] 이미 최신 상태"; else echo "[auto-pull] 🔄 $PULL"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",d.get(\"path\",\"\")))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.js ]]; then node --check "$FILE" 2>&1 && echo "[JS 검증] OK: $FILE" || echo "[JS 검증] ❌ 문법 오류: $FILE"; fi'

bash -c 'echo "
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"; echo "📋 변경된 파일"; git -C "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"'
